Chapter 850: Chapter 1: Soaring Comprehension Speed (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan compared the gap between himself and a perfect Level Eleven to that between Level Eleven and Level Ten, almost making the nine supreme beings of human civilization doubt whether Lin Yuan was actually at Level Eleven lifeform or not?

“From the beginning to the end of this universe, I reckon you’re probably the strongest Level Eleven there’s ever been,” the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said in a low voice.

So far, the Starry Sky Races hadn’t set a definitive number for the strongest Level Eleven.

Because most perfect Level Elevens relied on the empowerment of ultimate weapons.

Even so, there was constant debate about who was the strongest Level Eleven.

But now.

There was probably no debate anymore.

The strongest Level Eleven…

Was Lin Yuan.

And not just in this Cosmic Era.

In the many Cosmic Eras of the past and many more in the future.

The chances were slim that there would ever be a Level Eleven born stronger than Lin Yuan.

“Lin Yuan, with your strength, you could completely sweep through the upcoming grand-scale Battlefields of Different Races,” Xia Qin Supreme Being thought and immediately spoke up.

“Grand-scale Battlefields of Different Races?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred.

He had already heard about the grand-scale Battlefields of Different Races from Xia Qin Supreme Being.

This was a massive battlefield that surpassed any previous ones, a place where all peak forces of the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Skies contested for domination.

“That’s right.”

The eyes of the Ancient Power Supreme Being slightly lit up.

“The grand-scale battlefields are the arenas agreed upon by all peak forces within this universe through negotiation.”

“After the grand-scale battlefields are established, any force that obtains the right to lead the first war will gain one ten-thousandth of the territory of all participating clan forces,” the Void God Ultimate Being added from the side.

“One ten-thousandth of the territory?”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly solemn.

The Myriad Clans of the Cosmic Starry Skies fought on the many battlefields they opened, and under established rules, the victorious side would take control of the territory or some resource secret realms of the defeated side.

The Milky Way Star Region inhabited by Lin Yuan was, in the past, a territory ruled by the Shadow Tribe. However, in the battlefield, the Shadow Tribe lost to human civilization, which is why they had to hand over that region.

However, on the battlefields of the past, even the large battlefields, the territories lost through defeat didn’t reach the foundation of human civilization.

But what about grand-scale battlefields? Using one ten-thousandth of territory as the price?

How many Star Domains, to be precise, how many Star Alliances, would one ten-thousandth of human civilization’s territory envelop?

It should be noted that the size of the territory unequivocally includes more than just the number of lifeforms it can support; it also signifies countless resources.

Many precious resource planets and numerous Cosmic Secret Realms lie within certain territories, and once ceded, these too would be surrendered.

“That’s right.”

“That’s why for this grand-scale Battlefield of Different Races, those peak clan forces will spare no expense, they will even equip Level Eleven Fifth Realm lifeforms with ultimate weapons,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

According to the rules set by the Starry Sky Races for opening grand-scale battlefields, beings of the Twelfth Layer are forbidden from intervening.

With Twelfth Layer beings not entering the fray, the strongest combatants were naturally Level Eleven. To increase their side’s odds, outfitting perfect Level Eleven lifeforms with ultimate weapons is the foundation, and Level Eleven Fifth Realm lifeforms will be granted ultimate weapons.

To initially refine ultimate weapons, one needs at least the comprehension of the Fifth Realm of space and time, which means Level Eleven Fifth Realm.

But normally, Level Eleven Fifth Realm beings being granted ultimate weapons were very few and far between.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

From becoming an evolver to now, he’s been under the protection of human civilization.

Lin Yuan now also planned to give back to human civilization.

In fact, it wouldn’t be purely giving back, as Lin Yuan wasn’t obliged to go to the grand-scale battlefield.

According to the nine supreme beings, every Level Eleven who goes to the grand-scale battlefield would receive a large number of merit points as a reward from human civilization.

The merits established on the grand-scale battlefield could also be exchanged for a large number of merit points, and all the obtained spoils of war would belong to oneself.

With Lin Yuan’s strength now surpassing Level Eleven, even without an invitation from the supreme beings, he would plan to take a stroll on the grand-scale battlefield.

After all, to secure the right to lead the first battle on the grand-scale battlefield, those peak clan Level Eleven lifeforms will likely arm themselves to the teeth.

And for Lin Yuan, that’s all moving riches and treasures.

…

Heading to the grand-scale Battlefield of Different Races basically carried no risk for Lin Yuan.

“`

Anyway, going there with just his Primordial Spirit, even if it were to fall, Lin Yuan could quickly re-condense it.

After stepping into the Eleventh Level, even if a Supreme Being were to strike at Lin Yuan, at most they could only destroy his Primordial Spirit and not truly affect his actual body.

With over thirty-three million points in mental willpower strength, it’s enough for Lin Yuan to easily defend against any memory contamination at the Twelfth Level tier.

As for Causal Curse Killing? With Lin Yuan’s current level of life, even Twelfth Level beings would have to pay a huge price and still be unable to curse kill him.

Moreover, there’s the isolation of causality in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Simply put, the current Lin Yuan may indeed be unable to defeat those on the Twelfth Level, but for them to completely kill him?

It is also very difficult to achieve.

Or rather, it is impossible.

…

“By the way, are you planning to make public your breakthrough to the Eleventh Level?”

The Supreme Being Xia Qin thought for a moment and asked.

Up to now, the entry criteria for major battlefields have been the peak strength of the Eleventh Level powerhouses.

As for those below the Eleventh Level? To those in possession of the ultimate weapons at Level Eleven Perfect, the Tenth Level warriors don’t mean much.

Unless there is the Sea of Insects Tactics, brought about by the Insect Race Hives that have nurtured billions upon billions of Insect Race Warriors, otherwise it basically has no effect.

So——

The threshold to enter the large-scale Battlefields of Different Races is the Eleventh Level.

If Lin Yuan intends to enter the large-scale Battlefields of Different Races, he must reveal the power of the Eleventh Level.

“Make it public.”

Lin Yuan said calmly.

Previously, when he made the breakthrough from the Fifth to the Sixth Realm, in order to prevent being assassinated by different races,

Lin Yuan needed to keep his identity secret.

But now?

There is no need for secrecy anymore.

Because Lin Yuan has grown to such a height that those Supreme Beings from different races can no longer slay him.

And entering the large-scale Battlefields of Different Races, with Eleven as the threshold, announcing his step into the Eleventh Level is also to prepare for the large-scale Battlefields of Different Races.

“Actually, even if it’s made public, it doesn’t matter much.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said, given the potential shown by the Galaxy Master in the past, stepping into the Eleventh Level now, although slightly quick, is completely understandable.

From Level Seven to Level Eight, from Eight to Nine, from Nine to Ten, hasn’t the Galaxy Master surprised everyone every time?

…

After chatting with the nine Supreme Beings for a few more words,

Lin Yuan smoothly returned to the Milky Way Main Star.

“My physical body…the realm of the Xuanhuang Physique has fallen to Minor Accomplishment…”

Lin Yuan felt it for a moment and thought silently to himself.

To say that the realm of the Xuanhuang Physique has fallen is not accurate.

More precisely, the upper limit of the Xuanhuang Physique has been raised.

A Level Ten Perfect Xuanhuang Physique and one at Level Eleven Perfect are completely different concepts.

Lin Yuan, having stepped into the Eleventh Level, entered the eleventh chapter of the Xuanhuang Physique cultivation, the previous Level Ten chapter’s Xuanhuang Physique has not weakened in strength, but Lin Yuan has gained a greater space for improvement in this body refining secret technique.

“To cultivate the Xuanhuang Physique of the Eleventh Level to perfection…”

Lin Yuan’s brows slightly furrowed, after the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin, the strength of his physical body was too high, resulting in a very high starting point for the Xuanhuang Physique.

To progress, the cost of resources required far exceeds that of a normal Eleventh Level Xuanhuang Physique.

Of course.

This wasn’t necessarily a bad thing.

According to Lin Yuan’s estimation, with his current foundational bodily strength, once the Xuanhuang Physique is cultivated to the Level Eleven Perfect, in terms of physical prowess, he will surpass the ordinary Supreme Being level, approaching the Xuanhuang Physique at Level Twelve Perfect.

…

After contemplating the resources needed for the further cultivation of the Xuanhuang Physique, Lin Yuan was quite startled.

Moments later.

Lin Yuan stopped focusing on his physical body and began to comprehend the vast universal law fluctuations.

“My current comprehension speed…”

Lin Yuan slightly closed his eyes, only feeling as if the myriad rules and grand pathways of the universe were surging towards him.
